summary: Iter4 testing complete — variant A/B field end-to-end, /api/leads/stats aggregate, and non-blocking Resend email + Twilio SMS notifications. 11/11 backend tests pass; all FE flows pass (pro_first_mobile and control variants reorder correctly at 390x844, sticky across reload, POST body carries variant matching localStorage).
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.py cleanly gates Twilio on 4-key presence (sid/token/from/to) — confirmed by log lines 'Twilio SMS skipped — one or more credentials missing.' and 'Lead notification skipped (sms).' on every POST.

Resend send uses from=onboarding@resend.dev and to=LEAD_NOTIFY_EMAIL (jlgeneralcontracting24@gmail.com) regardless of lead.email, which is the correct pattern to avoid Resend's 'test-mode recipient must match account' restriction. Email log line 'Lead notification sent (email).' observed within ~100-400ms AFTER the 201 response (BackgroundTasks working as intended).
LeadCreate.variant is optional/nullable with max_length=40 — good. Empty string is normalized to None ((payload.variant or '').strip() or None). Clean.
/api/leads/stats uses $ifNull to bucket missing variants under 'unknown' — verified in test. Shares sum to ~1.0.
Minor: variant field has no enum/whitelist validation server-side; any 40-char string is accepted. Acceptable for an experiment but could drift if new variants are added without coordination.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth). /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required for this iteration.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed leads with variants (pro_first_mobile / control / null) inserted during pytest + 1 FE form submission (Iter4 FE / variant=control). Cleanly isolated via uuid-based emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter4 adds: (1) LeadCreate.variant optional field persisted to MongoDB + echoed in 201 response; (2) GET /api/leads/stats returns {total, by_variant:[{variant,count,share}]} with 'unknown' bucket for null variants; (3) FastAPI BackgroundTasks(notify_new_lead) fires Resend email + Twilio SMS fire-and-forget — HTTP response <1s even with email latency. Frontend: /app/frontend/src/lib/abVariant.js sticky 50/50 ('pro_first_mobile' | 'control') in localStorage 'ss_ab_pricing_mobile_v1'; Pricing.jsx sets data-variant attr and conditionally applies 'order-first md:order-none' on Pro card when pro_first_mobile. CTASection posts variant in body. Twilio SMS is dormant by design (SID/From/To empty); only Auth Token set. Verified log lines 'Twilio SMS skipped — one or more credentials missing.' and 'Lead notification sent (email).' post-response.

verification_evidence.backend_tests: 11/11 passed: test_create_lead_with_variant, test_create_lead_without_variant_is_unknown_in_stats, test_variant_control_in_stats (shares sum to ~1.0), test_post_leads_fast_response (<2s including network RT), test_stats_schema, and 6 regression tests on /, /audio/demo-call/script, /audio/demo-call, /status (GET/POST), /leads (GET).
verification_evidence.notification_logs: Confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: 'Twilio SMS skipped — one or more credentials missing.' + 'Lead notification skipped (sms).' on every POST. 'Lead notification sent (email).' observed ~100-400ms AFTER the 201 response (proves BackgroundTasks is non-blocking).
